data.name: SupportedScope
data.value: Bounded control-edge slices: WRITE_DAC, WRITE_OWNER, group-membership rights, password-reset permission and key-credential write permission. General membership writes and own-account-only Self-Membership are separate; named-holder requester operations remain unknown, while explicit bounded requester assessments are separate uncounted detail. Password-reset edges describe permission evidence, not a tested password reset or subsequent sign-in. Key-credential write edges describe permission evidence, not a tested key-credential write or subsequent sign-in. Validated-write-only key-credential access, ownership-derived control, replication, full-control aggregation and effective member expansion are not yet derived. Counts are not totals for all control capabilities.
